text:
sam: Kicking off the nightshift 'tide' run now — staggered cutover US -> EU -> APAC, 15m windows. Deploybot will post updates.
deploy-bot: start: rolling-deploy service=frontend version=3.2.0 region=us window=15m strategy=gradual
ops-bot: preflight: capacity-check passed (pool headroom 28%) in us-west; smoke pool warmed.
luna: noted — EU will be on a 20m hold after US to allow metric drift check.
kevin: quick heads-up: pinned canary concurrency to 80 req/s to avoid blast radius.
maya: please pin EU and APAC to v3.1.9 fallback in case we see latency regressions.
henry: copy, adding rollback marker and release-note link to ticket: https://rwd/ops/6543 — includes perf graphs and rollback checklist.
deploy-bot: progress: completed 40% of us shards; avg p95 latency +6ms (baseline +3ms) ; error-rate stable 0.12%
sam: good. ops-bot, run an on-the-fly capacity recheck at 50% and report whether we need to slow the window.
ops-bot: midflight capacity-check: headroom dropped to 18% due to a burst from warm-index rebuilds. Recommendation: throttle new canaries to 50% and extend window to 25m.
luna: agree with throttle. Initiating manual hold for EU until we confirm thermal and queue metrics settle.
kevin: doing throttle patch now: settings -> concurrency_limit=50, warmup_rate=0.6

```
# patch
service: frontend
canary: concurrency: 50
window_minutes: 25
```

maya: updating rollout policy: EU pinned fallback v3.1.9, notes added to release ticket. If error-rate > 0.5% for 5m -> auto-rollback.
henry: deploy-bot, can you emit a checkpoint when US is fully rolled and when EU hold is released?
deploy-bot: checkpoint: us_rollout=complete time=1729876578
sam: US looks healthy — p50/p95 fine, cost delta acceptable. Proceeding to unlock EU hold now.
deploy-bot: resumed: rolling-deploy service=frontend region=eu concurrency=50 window=25m
ops-bot: EU pre-smoke: 3/3 smoke checks passed. KV cache warm rates look good.
kevin: watching APAC capacity queue closely; will pre-warm and send go on green.
henry: reminder: change window ends 04:00 UTC — if APAC not started by 03:15 we pause and regroup tomorrow.
maya: noted. Also publishing short release note in #release-notes: "frontend 3.2.0 gradual deploy — rolling US, EU with conservative APAC start. Pin fallback v3.1.9."
deploy-bot: progress: eu 50% complete; metrics within thresholds.
sam: if EU p95 creeps > +30ms we stop and rollback to 3.1.9. Otherwise continue.
ops-bot: alerting channel if thermal throttling > 2 nodes or queue depth > 120 for more than 2 minutes.
kevin: APAC pre-warm done, signaling ready in 10.
henry: thanks everyone. Keep messages short updates only — call if we hit rollback triggers.
maya: final note — log the exact commit hash for audit: frontend@3.2.0 sha=ab3f4c9."
